resumeText:
Rohan Deshmukh | Pune | rohan.deshmukh@example.com

SUMMARY
Food and beverage service supervisor with 7 years in hotel restaurants, in-room dining and banquets.

EXPERIENCE
F&B Executive, Sahyadri Grand Hotel, Pune (2022 - present)
- Supervise service at a 90-cover all day dining restaurant and in-room dining.
- Execute banquet event orders for weddings and conferences of up to 400 guests.
- Lead daily briefings on menu changes, allergens and wine pairings for the service team.
- Run Oracle Micros Simphony billing and close outlet sales at day end.
- Drive upselling of beverages and desserts through monthly server contests.
- Prepare weekly duty rosters for a team of 18 stewards and captains.
- Handle guest feedback at tables and resolve service complaints on the spot.

F&B Supervisor, Deccan Courtyard Inn, Pune (2019 - 2022)
- Managed a team of 12 associates across breakfast and dinner shifts.
- Set up buffets and coffee breaks for corporate meetings.

SKILLS
FSSAI hygiene, HACCP, Micros, MS Excel

EDUCATION
B.Sc. Hospitality and Hotel Administration, Pune (2019)
